'''Xuanxuan''' is an NPC in [[Jinzhou]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xuanxuan:''' Excuse me, are you here to see the hamster too?
:'''Xuanxuan:''' No matter how many times you see it, it's still... just... SO CUTE!
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, that's their symbol, isn't it?
:'''Xuanxuan:''' I know, I know! Papa told me that they give nice things to good kids.
:'''Xuanxuan:''' Do you think my papa could be one of those people in hamster suits, too?
:'''Xuanxuan:''' He always brings me nice things every day.
{{Dialogue End}}
